answer: A seat binds to one E.164 number with STIR/SHAKEN 'A' attestation. Mid-epoch an STI-AS sends an INVITE; within 15 seconds the handset must DTMF the first eight hex of HMAC-SHA256(epoch-seed || E.164), a call-bound cipher. The verifier freezes echo cancellation so a taped tone cannot ride a residual tail. A second wallet on the same number, or colliding orig/dest-tn PASSporTs, burns 90 POA and merges both claims, so a SIM farm buys no extra weight. I filed at the zenith of the calling window. CDRs stay public four epochs; leftover collateral refunds after three sealed answers.
